abstract: Configures web framework builds for Capacitor: Next.js 14-16 static export, Nuxt 4 SPA generate, Angular application builder output, SvelteKit 2/3 adapter-static, Vite React/Vue/Svelte/Solid, React Router framework SPA mode, Qwik and Astro. Covers webDir mapping, SSR-only feature removal, Capacitor's index.html fallback routing trap, base paths, env vars, live reload, verification, and exact error fixes. Per-framework detail lives in references/.
triggers: web assets directory must contain an index.html
